# تَنَازَعْتَ (tanāzaʕta) /ta.naː.zaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# تَنَازَعْتِ (tanāzaʕti) /ta.naː.zaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# تَنَازَعَتْ (tanāzaʕat) /ta.naː.za.ʕat/: third-person fem
